senses.gloss:
Kubhā is the name of a river mentioned twice in the Rigveda,^1
and no doubt identical with the modern Kabul river, the
Greek Κωφήν.
1) v. 53, 9; x. 75. 6. Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 14; Ludwig, Translation
of the Rigveda, 3, 200.

Kubhra is the name of some animal in the Maitrāyaṇī
Saṃhitā (ii. 5, 3).
